# Private Unit3 independent qualification

This package carries the passive source/raw/execution observer, frozen independent
oracles, actual native/driver apparatus and internal seam-mutation adapters for
the private typed-project implementation. Public module syntax remains closed.

The source-only compiler corpus is one deterministic archive of exactly445 files
for152 original cases. Materialize it once into fresh external output and share
that physical source tree with all three collectors. Expected outcomes never enter
the compiler or passive observer. The independent comparison entrance reads the
same verified source tree and the separately frozen expectations.

The selected checkout is the reviewed platform-test successor a8e24a8d. The explicit
bridge first verifies its117 compiler inputs, restores only the hash-bound historical
test file in fresh staging, and verifies all117 original53ed core inputs. Semantic
receipts describe derived core-v1 with a production-byte identity bridge to the
selected successor. Ordinary repository checks compile the actual successor tests.
No historical source manifest or receipt is retargeted.

Standalone qualification matched all304 source case/profile observations. The
native proof includes300 primary invocations and96 actual source-free ELFs; the
mutation proof includes220 internal tuples and eight separately attributed driver
results. Portable transport was separately checked with four source observations
six native invocations/four source-free ELFs, and six mutation observations.
Full future CI uses explicit
304/300/220 plans and requires independent comparison after collection. A completed
collector is not itself a semantic pass.

Every supported portable entrypoint rejects optimized Python before executing a
worker. Run with PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 and python -B. The outer scripts bind exact source,
component, tool, library, build, request and receipt identities; frozen payloads are
internal components. Failure receipts, attempted streams, raw lengths/hashes and
lossless compressed outputs are retained. Native invocation does not probe external
tools before source admission and occupied-output checks.

See CI_COMMANDS.md for explicit commands and required tool paths. Run package
verification before qualification. Preserve the entire external output directory
on success and failure. The evidence directory records historical qualification
and narrow portability proofs; manifests containing old paths preserve provenance
and are not executable path defaults.

The staged comparison entrance selects runtime v2 (2c3cbff7), preserving the
runtime v1 attribution and adding independently checked pre-read regular-file
guards. The six retained mutation rows compare successfully with v2; the change
adds no compiler or native executions. Original semantic helpers and expectations
